status_note: Public prototype. Maturity labels are provisional, not verified production status.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Information & Knowledge
capabilities.description: Maintain structured property facts and historical records, including condominium matters, incidents, documents, decisions and outcomes, as a reliable source of property knowledge.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Inventory
capabilities.description: Register and manage property-specific equipment and assets, associating each inventory item with an equipment type and a property area to support operational activities.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Media
capabilities.description: Organize and maintain property images, renditions and multilingual descriptive metadata.

capabilities.name: Manage Consumables
capabilities.description: Maintain information about consumable supplies, stock levels and replenishment needs for property operations and guest stays.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Amenities
capabilities.description: Maintain a guest-oriented representation of property amenities, drawing on equipment and consumables to support accurate listings and guest communications.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Documents
capabilities.description: Organize, classify and monitor property-related documents, including their validity and compliance requirements.

capabilities.name: Manage Traveler Relationships
capabilities.description: Maintain traveler profiles, contact information and stay history to support personalized hospitality and ongoing guest relationships.

capabilities.name: Manage Enquiries & Reservations
capabilities.description: Manage booking enquiries, reservations, commercial details and booking status throughout the reservation lifecycle.

capabilities.name: Manage Guest Journey
capabilities.description: Support and coordinate the guest experience across pre-arrival, in-stay and post-stay interactions, maintaining continuity and relevant context throughout the journey.

capabilities.name: Understand Guest Feedback
capabilities.description: Collect, interpret and analyze guest feedback to understand experiences, identify recurring themes and support service improvements.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Maintenance
capabilities.description: Plan, assign, track and document maintenance activities across properties, equipment and service providers.

capabilities.name: Manage Cleaning & Preparation
capabilities.description: Schedule, coordinate and monitor cleaning and property preparation activities, including turnovers and intermediate services.

capabilities.name: Manage Service Providers
capabilities.description: Maintain service provider information, specializations and relationships, linking providers to operational activities and service history.

capabilities.name: Manage Operational Observations
capabilities.description: Capture, classify and follow up operational observations, transforming identified issues, quality risks and improvement ideas into actionable outcomes.

capabilities.name: Manage Stories & Context
capabilities.description: Connect existing information into meaningful histories of people, properties, stays and situations, preserving relationship context, commitments, decision rationale and outcomes without duplicating source records.

capabilities.name: Manage Contextual Communication
capabilities.description: Prepare, personalize and follow up communications with guests, owners and partners based on relationship history, current circumstances and interaction purpose.

capabilities.name: Support Contextual Decisions & Actions
capabilities.description: Support situation-aware decisions and next steps, considering goals, commitments, precedents and consequences while leveraging operational capabilities for execution.

capabilities.name: Manage Financial Transactions
capabilities.description: Record, classify and reconcile property-related revenues, expenses, payments and financial transactions.

capabilities.name: Manage Owner Accounts & Balances
capabilities.description: Maintain owner financial accounts, tracking property revenues, expenses, commissions, payments and outstanding balances.

capabilities.name: Manage Fiscal & Regulatory Obligations
capabilities.description: Calculate, monitor and support fiscal and non-fiscal regulatory obligations related to property management and hospitality, including tourist taxes, statutory declarations and accommodation reporting.

capabilities.name: Manage Pricing & Commercial Strategy
capabilities.description: Define and manage pricing policies, distribution strategies and commercial decisions to optimize occupancy, revenue and property positioning.

capabilities.name: Analyze Business Performance
capabilities.description: Analyze property revenue, occupancy, booking patterns, guest segments and financial performance to support management decisions.

capabilities.name: Integrate Channel Management Systems
capabilities.description: Exchange reservation, availability and channel information with external channel management platforms.

capabilities.name: Integrate Dynamic Pricing Systems
capabilities.description: Connect with external pricing optimization services to exchange pricing recommendations, rules and related commercial information.

capabilities.name: Integrate Website & Digital Content
capabilities.description: Make property information, media and related digital content available to websites and other presentation channels.

capabilities.name: Integrate External Services & APIs
capabilities.description: Exchange information with external services, public authorities and specialized platforms through supported APIs.

capabilities.name: Understand & Structure Information
capabilities.description: Interpret and transform unstructured information, such as messages, guest feedback, observations and documents, into structured knowledge usable by SIGA.

capabilities.name: Build & Apply Context
capabilities.description: Assemble and interpret relevant information about properties, people, stays, events and decisions to support situation-aware interactions.

capabilities.name: Generate Insights & Recommendations
capabilities.description: Identify patterns, risks and opportunities and suggest context-informed decisions or next steps.

capabilities.name: Orchestrate Actions & Workflows
capabilities.description: Coordinate and execute processes through rules, automation and progressively intelligent workflows, with human oversight where appropriate.

capabilities.name: Learn & Improve from Experience
capabilities.description: Use outcomes, feedback and decision history to progressively improve operational knowledge, recommendations and practices.

capabilities.name: Manage Data Persistence & Access
capabilities.description: Provide reliable structured data storage, retrieval and access to support SIGA's operational and analytical capabilities.

capabilities.name: Deliver Application Experiences
capabilities.description: Provide user interfaces and application experiences through which users interact with SIGA's capabilities.

capabilities.name: Execute Backend Services
capabilities.description: Run application logic, background processing and technical services required by SIGA's functional capabilities.

capabilities.name: Manage Digital Assets & Storage
capabilities.description: Store, retrieve and manage files and digital assets required by the platform.

capabilities.name: Manage Platform Development & Governance
capabilities.description: Support source control, development practices, deployment, configuration and technical governance throughout the platform lifecycle.
